title: ==CATALOG QUALITY & AI AUTOMATION MANAGER==  ·  TEST AUTOMATION

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Catalog Quality & AI Automation Manager== with **9+ years** of experience across UI and API test automation — from tool selection and framework design through script development, suite execution, and defect reporting. ==Managed test case preparation, execution, defect tracking, and status reporting as the QA lead on an automotive infotainment product==. ==Owned QA for 13 European e-commerce storefronts on the Magento platform==, differentiated by end-to-end ownership of QA across a 13-country e-commerce portfolio.

sections.note: JD MISMATCH — this is a catalog / product-data management role, not a software test automation role. Your QA and e-commerce experience is adjacent, not a direct match — address the domain gap in a cover note or skip this one.  FILL-IN RULE — every item in the bracketed row above is named by this job description but is not evidenced anywhere in your source resume. Keep only what you have genuinely shipped with and could be questioned on for twenty minutes; delete the rest, then delete the row label itself. Do not soften an entry to "exposure to".

roles.title: Senior QA Engineer
roles.meta: Feb 2022 – Present  |  Berlin, Germany  |  Secure email / enterprise web applications
bullets: Follow Scrum ==Agile== methodology across the team, collaborating with cross-functional teams to reproduce reported bugs and mentoring junior engineers.
Develop and maintain a test automation framework for web applications using Playwright with TypeScript.
Design and build test automation from scratch using the Cucumber framework for Windows-based, Android, and iOS Zertificon applications.
Build and maintain test automation for the Zertificon website using the Cucumber framework with Selenium and Java.
Write and maintain test cases for Zertificon applications in the TestRail test case management tool.
Use Gradle as the build management tool and Jenkins for CI/CD.

roles.title: Quality Assurance Manager
roles.meta: Mar 2019 – Jan 2022  |  Berlin, Germany  |  Automotive / in-car infotainment
bullets: Owned testing of the Volkswagen in-car infotainment app "We Experience" for the VW Passat and VW Golf as the sole QA resource on the product.
Analyzed real-time app performance while driving the vehicle and debugged logs from the car's backend systems.
Designed a test automation framework using Selenium, Java, and TestNG for the in-car infotainment app.
Automated infotainment system backend APIs using the REST Assured framework and Postman for manual API testing.
Used Maven as the build management tool and Jenkins / Travis CI for continuous integration.
Wrote test cases for the infotainment car application in the XRay test case management tool and produced daily and weekly status reports.
Followed Scrum and Kanban Agile methodology, managing test case preparation, execution, defect tracking, and reporting for the team, leading a team of [X] QA and automation engineers.

roles.title: QA Engineer
roles.meta: Oct 2017 – Jan 2019  |  Berlin, Germany  |  E-commerce (13 European markets)
bullets: Owned testing for all 13 e-commerce shops across Europe as the sole QA engineer.
Designed a test automation framework using Selenium with Java in the Page Object Model pattern, using Maven as the build management tool.
Developed automation scripts using TestNG and ran automated test suites in Jenkins.
Wrote automated test scripts using Codeception in PHP.
Wrote test cases from user stories and acceptance criteria and created test plans.
Tested application compatibility across browser versions (IE, Firefox, Chrome) and across mobile, desktop, and tablet environments.
Tested backend Magento e-commerce modules and deployed features to test servers for manual and automated testing.
Used Git for version control and worked within AWS infrastructure.
Performed the complete testing lifecycle — regression testing of fixed bugs and new builds, sanity testing, and user testing — following Scrum and Kanban.
